source: ladder, seeds 3 and 4 (24 rated games on regmc-mence, the belief agent over every legal row, D92), reviewed under the D93 coach
measure: mean coach luck (expected value of the played cell given the opponent's realised line, minus the evaluation of the next position) by the kind of our line; positive is the model's optimism
rule: a kind gets an offset when its measured luck exceeds twice its standard error over at least 15 decisions; re-measure every cycle with scripts/ladder_analysis.py
